note: How a finished (or running) Career is judged. Five pillars, each scored 0-100 and weighted. production uses the league's Hall of Fame score (full_at = the score worth 100); honours counts titles and awards; longevity is seasons played; public_image blends fan favour, media image and hype; character counts the tags earned by choices. The total picks a tier. Original names; edit numbers and words here, not code.

production: One of the great statistical careers
honours: A trophy case that fills a wall
longevity: A short stay in the league
A career that lasted a generation
character: Left a mark off the court
